arguments.sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS online_transactions FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Returns the average amount in dollars of all online transactions, along with how many online transactions there are.
assumptions: An 'online transaction' means transaction_type = 'Online Transaction', not one at a merchant location with city 'ONLINE'.
Negative amounts are included in the average as they are, because their meaning is not documented.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, across the whole data period (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
